meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一篇文章或一个选题,变成图文并茂的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有文字稿或选题,想快速做成能直接发布的解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn an article or topic into a graphics-and-text explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a script or topic and want a publishable explainer video fast

howto.what: 把你给的文章、笔记或主题逐步做成无真人出镜的讲解视频：每幕画面都是现设计的，包括排版、抽象图形、图表和数据可视化，最后渲染出视频文件。
howto.when: 当你给出一段文字（文章、笔记、主题等）要它做讲解视频时触发；用于主题讲解、概念拆解、操作教程等。从网站生成宣传或导览视频不归它管，不确定时先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇讲复利的文章做成 2 分钟的讲解视频
say.note: 会先确认简报，再逐幕搭建分镜

say.text: 配音换成男声重新生成
say.note: 会挑一个匹配的男声 id 传进去

say.text: 先给我看分镜方案，暂不做草图
say.note: 打开分镜板让你确认后再建画面

howto.what_en: Turns text you give it — an article, notes or a topic — into a faceless explainer video whose scene visuals are invented from scratch (typography, graphics, diagrams, data-viz), rendering a video file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you hand it text (an article, notes, topic) to make an explainer video; for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos. Not for videos built from a website.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a 2-minute explainer video
say_en.note: It confirms the brief, then drafts the storyboard

say_en.text: Redo the narration with a male voice
say_en.note: Passes a matching male voice id
